how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword will return the rolling mean of the series selected of the particular instrument.

This keyword has 2 inputs, one is to select the series, other is to select the period which is the no. of previous values to consider or the sample

![Example](./images/img-1719320626.png)

The above condition will return the mean of the NIFTY 50 close series, considering the sample data of the past 20 three minute candles
